name: compositions_assemble_score
title: Assemble the composition transcript score
description: UI helper for the composition editor: assemble an ordered set of (recording, start, end) segments into ONE continuous transcript score — the words from every recording stitched in order onto a single composition timeline, with a merged speaker legend and the recording-boundary seams between chunks. Read-only and stateless (nothing is persisted, no render). The editor calls this on every edit to re-render the spliced transcript; rendering an MP4 is episode.render.

segments.description: Ordered segments, same shape as episode.create. Output stitches them in this order.

recording_id.description: Recording public ID the segment is taken from.

occurrence_id.description: Stable Program occurrence identity when previewing an existing authored use.

selection.description: Optional { start_seconds, end_seconds } range (composition time) to open pre-selected/highlighted on the assembled transcript.

row_seconds.description: Optional transcript score row duration, in seconds. The web workspace sets this from rendered score width so narrow panes get shorter rows and dense speech remains legible.

include_rows.description: Whether to include timeline score rows. Defaults to true.

include_reading_rows.description: Whether to include reading-view prose rows. Defaults to true; the web workspace may request them lazily after first paint.

row_format.description: Optional timeline-row wire format. Defaults to object rows; compact_v1 returns positional row arrays for browser/widget transfer and must be expanded by the caller.

rows.description: Assembled transcript-score rows in composition time.

row_format.description: Present when rows use a non-default wire format such as compact_v1.

reading_rows_deferred.description: True when reading rows were intentionally omitted and may be fetched later.

legend.description: Merged speaker legend across the sources in range.

cuts.description: Display-only omitted same-recording transcript spans for expandable cut review, including timeline rows, reading-view rows, and a collapsed_by_default hint for long omissions. Rendering and playback still use the kept segments.

speaker_stats.description: Per-speaker share of the assembled composition (label, class_name, word_count, share).
